title: Privacy Shield Log Anonymizer
description: Redact IP addresses, emails, usernames, hostnames, tokens, API keys and other secrets from log excerpts in your browser before you share them.

title: Indirect Prompt Injection Sanitizer & Detector
description: Flag role spoofing, override directives, hidden text and encoded payloads in untrusted text before it reaches an LLM, with a reviewable sanitized copy. Runs in your browser.

title: LotL / LOLBAS Command Analyzer
description: Explain Windows command lines from logs and alerts that resemble documented LOLBAS abuse of built-in binaries, with ATT&CK ids from LOLBAS. Commands are analyzed as text and never executed.

title: MCP Security & Policy Checker
description: Static review of MCP client configurations and tool lists for secrets, risky launch commands, broad access and tool poisoning, with an optional policy check.

title: System Prompt & Agent Leak Inspector
description: Local review of system prompts and agent setups for secrets, internal details and weak protections, plus a leak check of responses against your prompt.

title: AI Model Bill of Materials
description: Planned inventory of model, dataset and dependency provenance.

title: MITRE ATLAS Attack Vector Mapper
description: Planned mapping of AI-system scenarios to MITRE ATLAS techniques.

title: LLM Prompt Injection Test Bench
description: Planned generator of prompt-injection test cases for authorized testing; no paid API calls.

title: YARA/Sigma Rule Validator & Converter
description: Planned local validation and conversion of detection rules.

title: Docker & Kubernetes Hardening Audit Generator
description: Planned hardening checklist generator for container configurations.
